dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetrical narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the central depigmented area and the darker lateral flanks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Prominent longitudinal linear mark of high contrast located on the posterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single elongated linear scar extending along the posterior dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Blowhole aperture visible as a localized dark-pixel cluster at the anterior dorsal apex.
